UnitPrice.description: The price for a single unit of this product.

PackType.description: The Package Type of the product

CountryOfOrigin.description: The Country Of Origin of the product

ReserveQuantity.description: The quantity reserved on backorder on the master/program.

VendorLeadWeeks.description: The number of weeks lead time

CustomerId.description: The unique Id assigned to your Account’s location. This CustomerID is not the same value as the user’s individual CustomerID.

NcnrQuantity.description: Date NCNR was signed.  Note:  If there is no NCNR applicable, the date will default to 1858-11-17.

MinimumReleaseQuantityOverride.description: Override for MFG Sales Pack.  If value is TRUE, MOQ = 1 pc unless there is a quantity greater than “0” in the Minimum Quantity Threshold field.  If value is FALSE, MOQ = MFG Sales Pack.

MinimumQuantityThreshold.description: *Only applicable if previous field “MinimumReleaseQuantityOverride” value = TRUE*.  The adjusted minimum order quantity.  If the value = “0” (the default) then the MOQ = 1 pc.  If the value is greater than “0”, that is the new MOQ.

NonCancelable.description: Supply Chain Non-Cancelable, Non-Returnable Agreement.  If value is TRUE, part is considered NCNR.

StandardPackage.description: The number of products in the manufacturer's standard package.

CustomerId.description: The unique Id assigned to your Account’s location. This CustomerID is not the same value as the user’s individual CustomerID.

BondedInventory.description: Does the location have bonded Inventory

Currency.description: ISO code for currency used in the order.
